name: 半拍长歌
look: a long one-handed sword forged from adamantine (a pale bronze-gold metal with a faint inner sheen); a plain, slightly worn cross guard and a grip wrapped in faded cloth; along the whole spine of the blade, from guard to tip, runs a neat row of forty-seven small dents, each one tapped in by a knuckle, and the dents glow very faintly gold like the notes of a song. Simple soldier's work, not ornate.

name: 莫菈的骨铃
look: a tiny bell carved from pale yellow bone, only as long as a thumb, polished smooth by years of handling, with one small chip missing from its rim; its clapper is a single round bone bead; it hangs from a short loop of faded blue cord. A faint milky-white light seeps through the thin bone shell.

name: 千风之种
look: a single very small pale seed, almond shaped, covered in fine intricate veins; the vein pattern seems to be drifting slowly like wind over grass; a few almost invisible threads of pale green-white breeze curl around it. It looks weightless, as if it might blow away.

name: 弑主长弓
look: a tall longbow whose limbs are made of a single pale blue-white bone, heavy and dense like iron, with old ritual notches near the grip; the bowstring is twisted from long black human hair; the grip is bound in dark worn leather. A cold, quiet sorrow; a thin crack of faint pale light runs along the upper limb.
